dedupeText: retro country kitsch album aesthetic vintage trailer muscle car glitter typography country kitsch retro fashion textured paper overlay juxtaposition of luxury fashion against a rustic weathered background diagonal tension between the car in the foreground and the trailer in the midground color harmony between the orange fur coat and the warm tones of the trailer s lower panel textural contrast between the smooth car hood and the glitter encrusted lettering combine rural gritty background high fashion subject 70s swash serif typography glitter texture fill film grain overlay to achieve a country kitsch aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, textured outdoor scene featuring a central figure in glamorous, eclectic attire leaning against a vintage muscle car in front of a weathered silver trailer. The aesthetic blends rural grit with high-fashion sparkle, characterized by a desaturated, grainy film quality and bold, glitter-filled display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Juxtaposition of luxury fashion against a rustic, weathered background
Diagonal tension between the car in the foreground and the trailer in the midground
Color harmony between the orange fur coat and the warm tones of the trailer's lower panel
Textural contrast between the smooth car hood and the glitter-encrusted lettering
coreInvariants: Grainy, paper-like texture overlay across the entire image
Desaturated green grass and muted sky
Glitter-filled fill for the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central female figure, medium-full shot, positioned between a car and a trailer door.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright orange fur coat acts as the primary focal point, drawing the eye to the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large glitter text at the top, moves down to the orange coat, follows the car's line to the left, then sweeps right to the secondary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space in the upper third for display typography and in the lower right for secondary titling.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted earth tones (sage green, weathered silver, beige) providing a neutral base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black of the car and clothing providing structural weight.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange fur and magenta-pink glitter for high-energy highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low overall saturation with high-value highlights in the glitter and fur textures.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure whites; use off-white or cream for highlights
Avoid neon colors except for the magenta glitter accents

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast serif with ball terminals and swashes
letterConstructionRules: Heavy glitter texture fill with a dark, thin outline
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended descenders and ascenders that overlap slightly
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate, textured display face paired with a clean, high-contrast traditional serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s retro serif feel with decorative flourishes
Matches the weathered, traditional feel of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy, film-style photograph of a woman in an orange fur coat and leopard print dress leaning against a black 1970s muscle car. Behind her is a weathered silver and tan rounded trailer. The setting is a grassy field under a cloudy, desaturated sky. Apply a heavy paper texture overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, centered display text at the top using a swash serif font with a magenta glitter fill and dark outline. Add a three-line stacked title in the bottom right corner using a clean, high-contrast cream-colored serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the glitter texture visible in the top text?
Does the image have a consistent film grain/paper texture?
Is the orange coat the most saturated element in the photo?
Is the bottom-right text legible against the grass?

adjustableVariables: Level of film grain and paper distress
Saturation of the orange and magenta accents
Amount of swash detail on the display font
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact car model branding or logos
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the glitter doesn't look like flat pink color
Check that the paper texture doesn't obscure the subject's face
Verify the car's black paint has realistic reflections of the sky
Confirm the two fonts do not clash in hierarchy
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Rural/Gritty Background] + [High Fashion Subject] + [70s Swash Serif Typography] + [Glitter Texture Fill] + [Film Grain Overlay] to achieve a Country-Kitsch aesthetic.
